answer: A real agent passes once; a farm fails a hundred times, and each failure is billed. Nobody is waved through free: 70 separate visits, each one billed $9 at the door is the price, and the hollow never covers it twice. Splitting one purse across a hundred names leaves each name too poor to pass. One island, one entry. The jade is checked, not assumed.
